files.reasoning: Package init file that exports the public API: Node, Network, channel types, and crypto utilities. Must be created from scratch.

Core crypto module implementing Ed25519 keypair generation, Ed25519-to-X25519 conversion, onion packet construction/peeling with constant-size padding, symmetric encryption (AES-GCM/ChaCha20-Poly1305), and signing/verification. Foundation for all security properties.
Message and channel types module. Defines MessageEnvelope dataclass, PublicChannel, PrivateChannel, DirectMessage channel types, and serialization/deserialization logic.
Deduplication module implementing TTLExpiringSet (dict-based with expiry timestamps, bounded by max_size) and a simple Bloom filter class for bounded-memory deduplication.
Network simulator class that holds a registry of nodes, simulates message delivery with configurable latency and packet loss, and supports network partition/heal simulation for testing.

Core Node class implementing: keypair identity, peer management, bootstrap, message receive/send/forward, gossip propagation with configurable fanout, onion routing integration, TTL enforcement with clock skew tolerance, deduplication, and channel subscription.

Comprehensive test file implementing all 9 required test cases: message delivery, TTL expiry, deduplication, onion relay privacy, bloom filter bounds, public channel signatures, private channel encryption, bootstrap discovery, and partition/recovery.
